test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate word. Choose the correct alternative.**

To make your own gargle, ______ half a teaspoon of salt in a glass of lukewarm or partly cooled boiled water.
solution:
The correct answer is '**dissolve**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word to fill in the given blank is '**dissolve**'.
 
• **Gargle **means a liquid used in gargling.
